name: perchlight-booking
description: A free, self-hosted booking page ("pick a time with me") on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + one Durable Object: your hours, your calendar's busy times, no double booking, invites and reminders.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters), e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Protects the admin API (/api/*): reading, cancelling and erasing bookings.

LINK_SECRET.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters). Signs the cancel / reschedule / approve links. Changing it turns every old link off.

IP_SALT.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters). Keys the rate limit's daily hash, so no IP address is ever stored.

CALENDAR_ICS_URLS.description: Recommended. Your calendar's private ICS link(s), comma-separated (Google: Settings > your calendar > Secret address in iCal format). Busy times there are never offered. A secret: anyone with it can read your calendar.

FEED_SECRET.description: Optional. 16+ random characters: your bookings feed is /feed/<FEED_SECRET>.ics. Change it to turn the old link off.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Recommended. Your Turnstile secret key (dashboard > Turnstile), checked on every hold. Also set TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY in vars.
